title: CreatePrintPartnerDesignRequest
description: Body parameters for creating a new design for a Print Partner.

bleed.description:
Bleed in microns to apply around the design in the editor. Bleed is the area
outside the trim line used to avoid white edges after cutting. Use 0 for no bleed. If bleed is not
specified, a default of 3000 microns is used.

min_pages.description:
Minimum number of pages the design must have in the editor. The user cannot
reduce the page count below this value. If both min_pages and max_pages are
provided, min_pages must be less than or equal to max_pages.

max_pages.description:
Maximum number of pages the design can have in the editor. The user cannot
add pages beyond this value. If both min_pages and max_pages are provided,
min_pages must be less than or equal to max_pages.

PrintPartnerDesignDimensions.description:
Dimensions of the design. Used to match a product type, or to create a custom-size design if
no product matches.

PrintPartnerDesignSource.description: The desired source for the design creation.

PrintPartnerDimensionsDesignSource.description: Creates a design that matches your dimensions. Add a product type for more precise template matches.

product_type.description: The product type is used alongside your dimensions to find a matching product in Canva Print's product catalogue, and templates for that product are recommended. If no match is found, only dimensions are used, so templates may include unrelated product types.

PrintPartnerProductIdDesignSource.description: Creates a design using an external partner product ID.

partner_product_id.description: The ID of the partner-defined product.
